title: Exclusive | Citigroup’s $35 Billion Bookkeeping Snafu Sparks Shake-Up in Upper Ranks
byline: Alexander Saeedy; Ben Dummett; Joe Wallace
html:
A $35 billion bookkeeping blunder in Citigroup’s C 1.99%increase; up pointing triangle London hub has sparked an internal shake-up and undermined efforts by America’s most error-prone big bank to repair its relationship with regulators around the world.

The bank over the summer injected approximately $3 billion into a major U.K. subsidiary after an employee revealed it had been undercounting a key measure of its balance sheet, said a spokeswoman, who described the error as an “internal capital modeling issue.”
